label: AI & Data
headline: From research questions
to evaluated AI systems.
summary: I turn data-driven questions into reproducible, evaluable experiments. My focus is establishing baselines, analyzing failures, comparing results against explicit criteria, and turning research or experimental output into usable capabilities.

freelance: Use Python for data exploration, model experiments, automation, inference APIs, and reusable tooling, with software boundaries designed beyond the notebook.
Integrate AI capabilities into wider products while keeping inputs, evaluation criteria, failure behavior, and human review explicit.
security: Bring an adversarial and evidence-oriented mindset to data leakage, unsafe inputs, dependency risk, model behavior, and validation.
Turn ambiguous findings into reproducible cases and concrete remediation—the same discipline required for trustworthy AI evaluation.
company: Built distributed mobile and web applications, creating a practical foundation for serving data- and model-driven capabilities inside larger products.
Shared ownership of architecture and delivery, connecting experimentation to operational constraints and maintainable integration.
